study.question: Does retaining only relational support-input gradients [q-k,q*k], rather than the separate-input family [q,k,action], improve the compressed task-conditioned incumbent at the same capacity and forward information?
study.hypothesis: Unused primary support rows influence the primary readout through batch-coupled Dice moments. Local source-role ablations leave a consequential ambiguity: g0-r0024-support_inputs_attached achieves click AUC0.666753547526167; history-only0.665288435647782, query-only0.6646155769630264 and neither0.6660086913506937. Thus either isolated role is worse than blocking both; neither role alone explains the full-path result. A provisional explanation is that paired relational derivatives through q-k and q*k preserve coordinated target/history adaptation, while direct q/k/action derivatives introduce unnecessary population-specific adaptation. Selectively keeping the relational family may retain this coordination and improve on both-attached. This is a parameterization-dependent optimization hypothesis, not a claim of new forward information or proven semantic alignment.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text, section4.3 lines250..274 and section5.2 lines317..335 inspected. DIN supplies target-dependent unnormalized activation pooling and batch-adaptive Dice; these are inherited prior components. The q,k,q-k,q*k,action arrangement is verified in the local implementation, not claimed to be the exact paper interaction formula. The proposed difference is backward routing by formed input family exclusively on nonreadout compressed support rows. No priority or novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 backward-only intervention on formed scorer input channels of primary support rows3..6: direct-family [q,k,action] gradient on/off crossed with relational-family [q-k,q*k] gradient on/off. Rows0..2 are always attached. In training, torch.where selects original versus detached channel slices; it changes no value and retains all affine/scorer parameter derivatives and all native Dice moment derivatives. In evaluation all cells use the exact native interaction/scorer path. Four standalone modules have identical learned construction; no added parameters, state, RNG, labels or information. Candidate is relational-only; the other three cells are controls.
predictions: Before training, all four cells must produce identical predictions and primary/auxiliary buffer updates at common parameters in both train/eval mode, within host BF16 tolerance, with exactly equal parameter counts and initialization. Both-attached must reproduce g0-r0024-support_inputs_attached and g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached under the same host recipe; neither should reproduce r0024 inputs-blocked within declared numerical tolerance.

Isolated support-term Jacobians must vanish for disabled families and remain live for enabled families; retained rows0..2, all scorer parameter gradients, native moment coupling and auxiliary source ownership must remain unchanged at fixed state. In eval, extra support rows are pointwise and cannot influence uniform output through batch moments.

If relational adaptation explains the coupled benefit, relational-only should beat direct-only and neither, and should preserve or exceed both-attached click AUC. Predeclare +0.0001 over both-attached as a practical exploratory advancement threshold, not a statistical significance threshold; report exact deltas even below it.

All four task AUC/Logloss, fixed history-length slice counts, parameters, train/wall/GPU allocation, peak memory and inference batch latency/throughput must be reported. Changed backward tensor operations may add training memory/runtime even at identical parameter count. No inference overhead is expected because all eval paths delegate to native code; this still needs measurement.
falsifiers: Reject implementation interpretation if fixed-state values or buffer updates differ, a disabled term leaks an operand gradient, a live term or scorer parameter loses its gradient, data/mask/auxiliary ownership changes, or either execution bridge fails numerical checks. Preserve failed costs and receipts; do not tune against withheld data.

If relational-only does not exceed direct-only and neither, the predicted relational sufficiency is unsupported. If only both families preserve quality, retain the incumbent and infer only that the tested partial routing failed; it does not refute relational mechanisms in other architectures.

A candidate below or effectively tied with both-attached does not establish a useful improvement; a small one-seed win is preliminary and must be tested with permitted paired repetitions. A win explained by runtime cost, gradient scale, action ownership, or parameterization does not establish semantic relevance or complementarity.

The historical summaries already contradict simplistic explanations: mean-only and variance-only moment gradients underperform both; aligned target partitions did not beat uniform readout; ordered cubic summaries and local energy normalization did not improve their matched controls. Do not relabel these as positive evidence.
alternative_explanations: Direct family includes historical action as well as q and k; this study cannot separate their effects.

q-k is algebraically redundant with q and k before the first affine layer; routing effects depend on this parameterization and may reflect gradient magnitude or optimization balance rather than semantic relevance.
Shared embeddings receive gradients through other roles, uniform readout and residual summaries; a detached support term does not freeze an embedding table.
One training seed, one temporal validation day and many prior adaptive comparisons; exact bridges do not constitute independent replications.
Training gradients and subsequent parameters can diverge despite identical fixed-state forward values; any effect on auxiliary tasks and runtime must be measured.
Native normalization populations include empty compressed slots. This is inherited and identical across cells, but may explain the broader source-family advantage independently of target alignment.

Auxiliary label semantics are user/category/brand 24-hour matches under official_offline visibility, not ad-specific conversions. Click improvement can coexist with auxiliary deterioration; the incumbent auxiliary AUCs are much lower than baseline DIN.

No additional authorized agent-memory hits were returned for support/gradient searches; absence of retrieval is not absence of prior work. Industry cards establish descriptions only, not transfer or originality.
